svg.title: Manufacturing and Conversion
svg.desc: BPMN process across Charles River Planning, Warehouse, Production, and Cost Accounting lanes. Supply planning leads to work-order release, material issue, labor-supported execution, standard-cost finished-goods completion, and a distinct later cost close.

div.div:
Boundary: planning and scheduling records do not prove approval or execution. Payroll supports labor; P2P supports component supply.
The separate variance model is a proposed analytical review, not a stored approval gate. Completion does not wait for that review or for all cost-close work.
